clos.original_description: Demonstrate understanding of key aspects of startup at a basic level
clos.enriched_description: Demonstrate basic understanding of startup concepts by recognizing entrepreneurial mindset, startup motivation, and the process of sparking and nurturing entrepreneurial spirit.

clos.original_description: Demonstrate the ability to build a right team and express effective teamwork
clos.enriched_description: Demonstrate the ability to build a right team and express effective teamwork. The scope includes Seminar 1 and “Be Successful in Your Own Way” - Guest speaker.

clos.original_description: Able to conduct survey and do market research
clos.enriched_description: Able to conduct survey and do market research. The scope includes Understand Customer and Find Market-fit and Market Research.

clos.original_description: Able to build the right product and the reasonable business model
clos.enriched_description: Able to build the right product and the reasonable business model. The scope includes Build Product and Business Model.

clos.original_description: Able to create a preliminary pitch deck and present it convincingly
clos.enriched_description: Create a preliminary startup pitch deck and present it convincingly. The scope includes fundraising concepts, startup management, and introducing the startup idea in a structured presentation context.
